runtimeMapping.ordinary: One ground target; original .733 Attack event in bound facing, playback min(1,ASPD/100); input target retained, no release retarget.
runtimeMapping.s1: Source charge_cost ON_BUFF_START runs once at skill activation; inherited wait-event startup not recovered, immediate grant is bounded to selected instant DP behavior.
runtimeMapping.s2: DEFAULT next-attack trigger in normal attack range; release retargets all legal ground enemies in selected x-5 cross, without radial splash. One DP grant on completed release even if initial target has left. Charges and scale use selected rank.
runtimeMapping.s2Clock: Original Front Skill OnAttack 1.133 and duration 1.667 at capped ASPD rate. Serialized preDelay1/timeMode1 is retained and bounded as overlapping lower-bound preparation, not an extra additive second. Exact dispatcher ordering is not recovered.
runtimeMapping.s2Back: Original Back has no Skill. Use the known Front Skill release clock for gameplay; keep Back Idle without inventing a Back animation/event or forcing front. This is explicit simulator fallback, not native reconstruction.
runtimeMapping.s2Finish: Suppress ordinary attacks and ordinary SP from windup through original Front Skill clip completion. Core instant skill ends at release; source-owned cast lock persists to clip end. Control or retreat before hit cancels damage and DP with no invented refund.
runtimeMapping.s3: Selected duration; +1 additive BAT, selected attack scale and independent 40% selected stun per valid physical strike. Original Attack_2 event1.067 in both bound facings at capped ASPD rate. No generated DP.
runtimeMapping.t1: Live source-owned ATK/DEF percentage aura for every deployed Vanguard including Siege, irrespective of distance; no permanent squad modifier, detaches on withdrawal/death.
runtimeMapping.t2: At actual enemy death, including kills by other sources and flyers, if body overlaps selected x-5 keys and Siege is alive/deployed/visible: selected forced SP bypasses active/noSp and clamps shared charge capacity. No SP on escape, disappearance, revival or later redeployment.
